run_ateacher_training: run the ATeacher semi-supervised object detection training pipeline with a config file
run_baseline_training: run the baseline semi-supervised training pipeline using BaselineTrainer with a config file
eval_ateacher_model: evaluate an ATeacher model using EnsembleTSModel and DetectionCheckpointer for testing
eval_baseline_model: evaluate a baseline model using DetectionCheckpointer to load weights and run tests
setup_ateacher_config: setup and merge ATeacher config from a YAML file with command line options
